scope: Software transport and isolated verification, not a new financial run or completed whole-strategy experiment

implemented.configuration_transport: Four actual admission components consume a task-local immutable threshold view: research rank canary, sniper subprofiles, late momentum watch and moonshot. CFG, cached core filters and open-position exit configuration are not mutated
implemented.bounds: One component and at most two finite adjacent admission thresholds per experiment. Amounts, quotas, live permissions, route requirements, impact limits, credentials and exits are outside the allowlist
implemented.extreme_returns: Maximum recent-price-change thresholds can be examined above 1000 percent without introducing a take-profit ceiling. Increasing an entry threshold does not establish a winning buy. Existing uncapped runner exits and exact 0.1 SOL paper execution are preserved
implemented.integration: The guarded main entry path reads only a checked paper-entry-gate manifest, binds a single snapshot through async waits, clears obsolete queued snapshots and restores baseline context on completion, exception or cancellation. Configuration hashes, decision token metadata and paper portfolio entries retain selected-policy provenance
implemented.evidence_transport: Generic exported profiles and scalar replay reports cannot activate. An original declared 24-hour cohort with at least 50 distinct valid mints is rechecked against current component configuration and the actual pure gate functions. Missing, unsettled, duplicate, stale, mismatched or altered cases reject
implemented.cash: Both gate arms use one common frozen quoted entry/exit cash record when either buys. Entry is exactly 0.1 SOL, raw SPL quantity and net USD/SOL conservation are rechecked, and estimated fees/slippage remain explicit. Only a known policy skip contributes zero; a missing hypothetical buy/quote is unknown and rejects
implemented.comparison: One predeclared challenger, at least ten changed admission decisions, positive selected net SOL and USD, and positive paired bootstrap lower mean improvement in both currencies. This is gate-component evidence, not a capital-constrained whole-strategy profitability certificate
implemented.runtime_limits: No provider calls or transaction sends in selection or gate replay. Evidence objects, cohort cardinality and cache are bounded; full source proof rechecks occur within five seconds. Corrupt, missing, expired or incompatible artifacts fall back to configured thresholds
